content:
lena: Heads up — a visiting string quartet arrives Wed 11:40am with two wooden crates, one marked FRAGILE. Need temp badges, a place for cases, and seating for warmup/performance. Can we avoid the kitchen area?
reception: We'll intercept the courier. Please confirm visitor names and who is escorting. Front desk can issue temp badges.
marta: I can handle badges. Who are the musicians?
lena: Visitors: Mr Tanaka, Ms Ito, Mr Yamada, Ms Ruiz. Escort: @marta and @kai.
people-ops-bot: Quick reminder: temp-badge pickup at reception takes ~30s. Please pre-fill the guest form: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-guest-form
kai: I have 4 folding chairs and 3 music stands in storage, can bring them over. Also happy to help move the couch if needed. :musical_score:
jong: Where do we stash the fragile tile crate? Noticed last time crates got stacked and one cracked.
reception: Locker 3 is free tomorrow AM (2m x 2m). You can place the crate inside. Please sign for parcel and leave a photo in #packages. Code for locker: 4271 (front desk will set for you).
marta: Great — I'll sign and put labels on the crates. Also heads-up: one musician needs level floor space close to power for a foot pedal. Accessibility noted.
sophie: I'll reroute the lobby bench and clear the small platform so they have a minimal stage. Couch Tetris in the afternoon — moving couch to Conf B for the morning. :couch: :sweat_smile:
lena: Schedule for planning (will post at reception):
```
11:40 — arrival & crate dropoff (reception)
12:00-12:30 — warmup (lobby platform)
12:45-13:30 — lunch (kitchen tables / reserved area)
13:45-14:15 — short performance in lobby
14:30 — depart
```
marta: I'll bring the spare packing foam and some tape just in case. Who's on photo duty to log the crate?
sophie: Me. I'll post a pic in #packages when courier shows.
jong: FYI if a box arrives labeled 'Ceramics Co' or 'Tiles Intl' that's probably the fragile one — don't put it in the mailroom stack.
kai: OK I'll be there at 11:20 to help. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
